0.original: Vuyargur has received another golem repair request.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Speak with Xarhorkur at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

2.original: Deliver the requested items to the golem tinkerer.

24.original: Speak with Xarhorkur at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

48.original: Forgive me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but could I entrust you with more golem maintenance? Though its function is restored, a construct of its age needs regular upkeep.

49.original: In the time since your last repair, a new malfunction has arisen, and it seems more parts will need replacing.

50.original: Xarhorkur should have more information for you. You'll find her at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

51.original: Glad you're here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The components we need are rather intricate, which is why I requested you and your deft hands for the job.

52.original: Lest you worry, I've got all the materials you need to forge them right here. Let me know if you run out!

53.original: Lest you worry, I've got all the materials you need to construct them right here. Let me know if you run out!

54.original: Lest you worry, I've got all the materials you need to prepare them right here. Let me know if you run out!

55.original: Oh, and once you've finished, go ahead and take them to the tinkerer for installation.

56.original: Need more materials? ...No, evidently not. Carry on, then! The tinkerer will be glad to see you!

59.original: Need more materials? Certainly! Here you are.

62.original: Hrmmm... Perhaps I ought to fine-tune the motor component...?

63.original: Your presence is a welcome one, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203> artisan. Have you a job in need of the golem's strength?

64.original: Oh, you're a saint! With any luck, these replacement parts will stop it from making that dreadful grinding sound... The keeper will be thrilled!

65.original: Oh, your timing couldn't be better! Whatever was causing that delayed response time, these replacement parts ought to fix it. The keeper will be thrilled!

66.original: Granted, we're still learning through trial and error at this stage, so we may have need to call upon you again, if that's all right. Many thanks!

67.original: Once again, our golem is restored by your hand. Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

68.original: Doubtless you have witnessed similar constructs in the region of Yak T'el─the former guardians of the old quarries.

69.original: I should like to see them for myself one day, to take comfort in the unweathered vestiges of our ancestors.

70.original: Much like our sepulchres, the structures we build are bearers of memory. It is a golem's duty to ensure they last for generations, and ours to ensure the golems do the same.
